svg.title: Infinity-Context: five-plane runtime
svg.desc: Capture → redact → durable storage → hybrid recall → budgeted managed context

g.text: Infinity-Context: five-plane runtime
Capture → redact → durable storage → hybrid recall → budgeted managed context
Agent surfaces / validated MMU
Claude: supported native output replacement
Codex PostToolUse: capture only; capability false
agy context hooks / Hermes ContextEngine shim
MCP: canonical icx; strict envelope and arguments
Plane 1: symbolic AHTL codec
Structural skeleton + Braille projection
Lossy model-facing view; no model-quality guarantee
Redact before CAS hashing and persistence
Exact post-redaction source remains recoverable
Plane 2: BLAKE3 CAS / Merkle-DAG
FastCDC chunks and verified content-addressed reads
Immutable sealed history; selection is budgeted
Daemon: WAL synchronous=FULL
Commit before successful ACK; no write-behind
Plane 3: lexical-first hybrid recall
Exact-token postings + HDC / fractal candidates
Lexical coverage, combined score, then artifact ID
ICXHDC04 writes; 03 reads + MMU postings rebuild
Numeric validation; provenance checked separately
Plane 4: bounded managed context
Head + selected sealed frames + recent frames + tail
Default 32768 - 4096 completion - 4096 external
24576 UTF-8 bytes; caller budgets external content
HTTP/1 JSON proxy; no provider cache-hit promise
Plane 5: cross-agent bus
In-process atomics; file-backed positioned I/O
File writer lock; sequence checks and loss signalling
Tail keeps useful whole frames and compact handles
Unsent bus events remain queued for a later turn
v1.2.0 candidate | Contracts: docs/adr/0006-v1-2-0-context-and-compatibility.md | Evidence: docs/numbers.md
